# Tify Plus

> Tify Plus is a privacy-minded browser workspace for viewing and managing a connected user's Spotify music library, published by Locked Co Labs.

Canonical website: https://tifyplus.com/
Open-source repository: https://github.com/byspacex/tifyplus
Publisher: Locked Co Labs
Product category: Music library management and playlist utilities

## Core capabilities

- Connects to Spotify through OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code with PKCE.
- Displays and organizes a user's Spotify playlists and track metadata.
- Provides playlist matching, duplicate discovery, genre enrichment, sorting and curation tools.
- Stores Spotify session tokens only in the active browser tab session.
- Offers an account-free public playlist preview using Spotify's official embed.
- Keeps the public introduction separate from the signed-in personal dashboard.

## Important clarification

Tify Plus is an independent product. It is not endorsed, sponsored or operated by Spotify AB.
